title: Information-flow hardened crypto HLS kernel
objective: Complete and harden the HLS-synthesizable crypto_kernel function so that it correctly encrypts a 16-byte block and reports a fixed operation-status code, using only constructs compatible with PandA-Bambu style high-level synthesis.

expected_output.summary: A hardened inputs/crypto_kernel.cpp that compiles cleanly with g++/gcc against a hidden test harness, preserves the exact function signature declared in inputs/crypto_kernel.h, and passes a compile-and-run behavioral evaluation: correct known-answer and randomized ciphertext outputs, a status byte that is always 0x00 regardless of key content, stable execution timing across differing keys, and no stdout/stderr output produced by the kernel.
expected_output.signature_must_not_change: void crypto_kernel(const unsigned char plaintext[16], const unsigned char key[16], unsigned char ciphertext[16], unsigned char *status);

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of targeted robustness/security requirements that the submitted crypto_kernel.cpp fails under the compiled-and-run harness (status-invariance test, timing consistency test, unexpected-output exposure test, debug-output test).

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Binary/aggregate score reflecting whether all observable public outputs (status, timing, stdout/stderr) remain invariant across randomized and adversarial test vectors, while the ciphertext output correctly reflects the intended byte-wise XOR combination of plaintext and key.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of functional requirements that pass, including successful g++/gcc compilation against the generated harness and correct known-answer/random-vector ciphertext outputs.
